cards.text: Meet Nicodemus, a Pharisee and a leader of the Jews. He comes to see Jesus at night and opens with, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God.” That's a BIG opener, and in all my years stuck in a junk drawer, the nicest thing anybody ever said to me was “Scoot over.”

cards.question: Nicodemus tells Jesus that no one could perform the ___ He is doing if God were not with him.

cards.text: Jesus replies, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.” Nicodemus walked in with a compliment and walked STRAIGHT into the deep end.

cards.question: Jesus tells Nicodemus a person must be born again. What does Nicodemus picture?

answers.text: A grown man being born a second time
A grown man taking on a new name
A grown man moving to a new country

cards.text: Jesus answers with another “Truly, truly, I tell you,” and says no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit. Then He adds that flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.

cards.question: Jesus tells Nicodemus not to be ___ that He said, “You must be born again.”

cards.text: Then Jesus points to the wind, which blows where it wishes.

cards.question: Jesus tells Nicodemus the wind blows where it wishes. What does He say you can tell about the wind?

answers.text: You know where it comes from
You know where it is going

cards.question: Jesus uses the wind to describe everyone who is born of the Spirit.

cards.text: Nicodemus asks, “How can this be?” I've BEEN that guy, friend: nodding through the whole explanation, then asking the one question my brain can still hold.

cards.question: Jesus answers Nicodemus by pointing out who he is. What does Jesus call him?

cards.text: Then Jesus follows it up: “…and you do not understand these things?” That's like being head baker for twenty years and finding out the oven had a light in it the WHOLE time.
Then comes another truly, truly from Jesus. He says we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen.

cards.question: Right after saying “we testify to what we have seen,” Jesus tells Nicodemus that “you people” accept that testimony.
Jesus says to Nicodemus, “If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe…” What does He ask next?

answers.text: How they will believe if He tells them heavenly things
Why they will not listen to the prophets
When they will finally ask Him for a sign

cards.text: Nicodemus showed up with one compliment, and friend, he is getting the WHOLE lesson. Jesus says no one has gone up into heaven except the One who came down from heaven, the Son of Man.
Then Jesus brings up Moses, Israel's leader, who lifted up a bronze snake on a pole in the wilderness, and anyone bitten who looked at it lived (Numbers 21:8-9).

cards.question: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, what does Jesus say must also be lifted up?
Jesus says the Son of Man is lifted up so that everyone who believes in Him may have ___ life.

cards.text: And then comes the verse half the world has on a bumper sticker: “For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.”

cards.question: Jesus says God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world. Why did God send Him?

answers.text: To save the world through Him
To give the world a new law
To rebuild the temple in Jerusalem

cards.text: Jesus says whoever believes in Him is not condemned. Then He turns to the other side.

cards.question: Jesus says whoever does not believe in the name of God's one and only Son has already been condemned.

cards.text: Now Jesus gives the verdict, and I'm leaning in like it's the last ten seconds of a courtroom show. The Light has come into the world.

cards.question: Jesus says the Light has come into the world. How do people respond to it?

answers.text: They gave thanks for the Light
They waited for a greater sign

cards.question: Jesus says people loved the darkness rather than the Light because their ___ were evil.

cards.text: Jesus says everyone who does evil hates the Light and does not come into it.

cards.question: Jesus says the one who does evil does not come into the Light. Why does he stay out?

answers.text: He fears his deeds will be exposed
He thinks the Light is too far away
He is waiting for someone to lead him

cards.question: Jesus says whoever practices the truth stays away from the Light too.

cards.text: Jesus says whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, “so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.” Nicodemus came to Jesus at night, and Jesus ends the whole talk on the Light.
